properties.name: Belváros
properties.sourceSemantics: Original municipality defined10városrészek; multi-name legend units remain whole and are not independent constituent-name boundaries.
properties.method: Native625×883 original2014 municipal JPEG color-mask extraction. Manually identified source-colored components use documented HSV classes and4-neighbour connectivity. Small enclosed source-number/CAD-ink mask holes are filled after source review; white exterior/rural gaps and separate components are not bridged. Every native contour edge follows actual classified pixel-cell boundaries; only exactly collinear cell-edge vertices are omitted. Fourteen components retain raster-color estimates of the drawn outline. Two specifically reviewed CAD/digit-occluded silhouettes (northeast8 and northernmost9) instead follow closed8-neighbour cycles of actual dark source pixels (maxRGB165) within3px manually identified outer-stroke corridors; their full RGB/pixel paths are archived. No missing dark-pixel gap is bridged. WGS84 positions use an INFERRED, unvalidated EOV similarity from two assumed source-image/modern-road-node correspondences. Literal modern node coordinates are verified, but no image correspondence or independent physical holdout is established. No hull, image-frame closure, arbitrary closing chord, buffering, repair, current-road boundary substitution or clipping to current municipal limits. Unknown absolute accuracy remains null.
